paper.$description: Paper — Page backgrounds, navigation, text-on-dark, and light button surfaces

ink.$description: Ink — Display headings, navigation, body copy, icons, dark media panels, and hairline graphic details

near-black.$description: Near Black — Secondary dark text and headings where pure Ink is not used

quiet-graphite.$description: Quiet Graphite — Supporting body copy, explanatory text, and subdued interface labels

soft-gray.$description: Soft Gray — Muted metadata, inactive supporting text, and low-emphasis labels

oat-surface.$description: Oat Surface — Feature-card surfaces, pale pill buttons, understated separators, and surface outlines

ledger-brown.$description: Ledger Brown — Filled pill buttons and dark navigation controls — the brown-black fill keeps conversion controls tactile rather than corporate-blue

espresso-panel.$description: Espresso Panel — Dark product-demo surfaces, data-led card backgrounds, and high-contrast visual blocks

copper-link.$description: Copper Link — Inline product-card links and compact interface highlights — a warm cue that reads as commerce material rather than a universal brand wash

terracotta-disc.$description: Terracotta Disc — Large circular decorative card accents and isolated graphic moments

active-green.$description: Active Green — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

active-green-surface.$description: Active Green Surface — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

pending-ochre.$description: Pending Ochre — Yellow text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

expiry-red.$description: Expiry Red — Red text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

harbor-depth-gradient.$description: Harbor Depth Gradient — Dark atmospheric product-media backdrop

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

inter-variable.$description: Primary display and interface family. The 82px weight-400 display treatment is deliberately light for its scale; its tight tracking makes large claims feel typeset rather than loud.

inter.$description: Navigation, body copy, buttons, links, card content, and secondary headings. Medium-weight 14px navigation uses notably tight tracking, so menus read as small typeset labels rather than utility chrome.

ibm-plex-mono.$description: Uppercase eyebrow labels, category labels, and product-media captions. The monospaced labels create a compact payment-infrastructure register against the soft editorial display type.

adamina.$description: Customer quotation copy; the restrained serif separates testimonial voice from product-interface text.

inter-tight.$description: Inter Tight — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
